mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which trigger preemptive monetary tightening and reduce equity forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which triggers a dovish policy response and reduces equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 104.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 319.5 and FEDFUNDS above 4.3% signals a persistent inflationary environment that sustains restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both CPIAUCSL > 319.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.3%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 4.2% and rise in PAYEMS above 159,400 thousand signals a labor market overheating that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.2 and PAYEMS > 159400, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 722,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts above 1.5 million units, signals strong aggregate demand that fuels inflation and triggers monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both RSAFS > 722000 and HOUST > 1500.0, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 23,540 billion dollars, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 320), signals a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, even under moderate policy rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 23540 and CPIAUCSL < 320, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
